scope: Shared original-board spatial candidates during PCB editing previews
implementation: SnapCache shares an Arc of the already prepared source spatial tree; it does not clone the display caches or retain a Board.

Revision changes invalidate candidates. A preview before any source frame builds a spatial-only fallback.
Off mode skips item candidate preparation/query but retains core grid snapping. Ctrl+Shift bypass remains raw.
